triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: lattice doctor output contains a host burn scan section that flags threshold-exceeding host sessions by file, cwd, and cumulative tokens (and usage_sweep --alert exits non-zero on flagged sessions), verified by the fixture-driven usage-burn-alert smoke plus a real-machine doctor run, while plain doctor/usage_sweep exit codes and the zero-write contract stay unchanged.

Red evidence targets the snapshot requestHash and the same_acceptance green relation re-runs the literal doctor probe.
